$comment: Advisories this repository has seen and accepted for now, each with the issue that tracks it.
The daily scan (.github/workflows/security-scan.yml) reports anything NOT in this list, and the
publish gate fails on a critical not in it. An entry without an issue is rejected outright: an
acceptance nobody is tracking is how a finding becomes permanent.
Remove an entry when its issue is fixed - the scan prints the ones nothing finds any more.

Seeded 23 October 2026 from npm audit --omit=dev and Trivy 0.76.1 (#2118). Reseeded the same day from the scan's own run 39984219123, on sha-ee1a9e4: the 232 entries it no longer found were removed, the 30 it did were kept (the three tied to the closed #2112 now point at #2122), and its one new finding, node-jose, was added.
23 October 2026: the nodemailer entries were removed when nodemailer 10 merged (#2115, PR 2153).
23 October 2026: the entries for the retired IdP's packages (oidc-provider, node-jose, and @koa/cors and node-forge, which came only through them) were removed with the IdP (#2158).

23 October 2026: the four image findings under #2117 (brace-expansion twice, http-cache-semantics, undici) were removed with npm itself, which carried them, from the API images' runtime stage (#2172).
